notes.title: Happy International Workers' Day: NEFM New Map Preview & Recent Updates Summary
notes.content:
Allow me to extend my most cordial Labor Day greetings in advance. The NEFM (Non-Evacuation Frontier Module) is anticipated to unveil its new map on [h3]May 4th[/h3]. Herein lies a preview of the forthcoming cartographic expansion.

[h1]New Map Preview[/h1]

A novel locale—Eerie Ruins—shall soon emerge, presenting extreme peril with densely clustered adversaries. Players are advised to equip themselves thoroughly before venturing into this treacherous domain.
Accompanying the map's debut, several innovative items and crafting formulae shall be introduced, awaiting your discovery.
New side quests and randomized missions will be integrated into the uncharted territory.
Fresh horrors emerge: the Necrotic Slug, alongside a formidable new boss—the Omen's Ovum.
A novel merchant NPC will inhabit the map, their wares ripe for exploration.
Additional armor sets and helmets shall augment your defensive arsenal.
Concurrently, numerous known bugs shall be rectified.
Necrotic Slug:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266628/03c2cb0a625cf4f0420cef437a3fecee55242b51.png[/img]

Omen's Ovum:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266628/ed696ba5c23f3bcd2c7e0abe3278311981c4afef.png[/img]

Furthermore, this missive consolidates prior updates to enhance your comprehension of recent modifications, ensuring an elevated gameplay experience.

[h1]Performance Adjustments[/h1]
[] Drastically reduced looting duration for containers: 2.5s → 1s.
[] Reconstructed damage calculation mechanics: Direct health depletion now occurs only when Armor Durability ≥ 0 and Projectile Penetration ≥ Armor Tier; otherwise, armor durability is prioritized.
[] Added tier-based damage mitigation: Superior armor reduces incoming damage—seek out sturdier protection!
[] Refined enemy AI: Adversaries no longer exhibit "speedster" sprinting behaviors.
[] Expanded stack limits for most materials—intuitively stackable items now function as expected.
[] New alert system for agents entering maps unarmed.
[] Drag-and-swap functionality for equipped weapons.
[] Finalized "Quick Sort": Items now auto-arrange categorically, with single-slot objects filling interstitial spaces.
[] Instant Loot: Strip all valuables from fallen foes with a single command.
[] Enhanced hit reactions: Visual feedback for successful strikes intensifies combat immersion.

[h1]Quality-of-Life Enhancements[/h1]
[] Streamlined early-game: New saves now begin with a fully-equipped complimentary agent (non-conflicting with existing characters).
[] Exploration safeguard: First-time map fatalities grant a single resurrection.
[] Zombie audio overhaul: Pre-remaster, undead vocalizations no longer spam repetitively.
[] Refined loot distribution: Material scarcity issues alleviated via logical drop allocation.
[] Collision recalibration: Smoother environmental interactions for player models.
[] Ballistic audio polish: Firearm reports now resonate authentically.
[] Damage metrics: Weapon efficacy visibly quantified.
[] Armor repair cap: Restoration costs never exceed base item value.
[] Mi-Go Boss refinement: Revamped hit detection and attack animations improve combat pacing.
[] Starter weapon upgrade: AK-series firearms now default (with readily available ammunition/attachments).
[] New-agent mobility boost (legacy save data remains unadjustable).
[] Eliminated rogue pipes in obsolete hideouts.
[] Performance optimization: Addressed low-end PC stuttering in Map 5 zones.
[] Alpine lighting upgrade: Snowfield post-processing effects refined.
[] Guaranteed quest drops: "Bloodstained Report" now always obtainable via single boss engagement.
[] Sightline expansion: Player visibility radius significantly widened.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[] Armorless damage formula patched: Attacks now correctly injure unprotected targets.
[] Island collision fixes: Phantom barriers reduced in coastal regions.
[] Glacial statue interaction: No longer retriggers upon repeated examination.
[] Instant Loot stabilization: Functionality now consistently operational.
[] Clipping mitigation: Walls less likely to trap players.
[] Base-building overlap resolved: Workshops no longer merge.
[] Reload tier correction: Max-level reload perks now apply.
[] Post-quest text purge: Erroneous "slay a chicken" prompt removed.
[] Typography unification: Font scaling standardized; select UI elements resized.
[] Zombification glitch: Mid-injection deaths no longer spawn undead states.
[] Grenade physics: Projectiles now bypass obstacles; detonations properly harm.
[] AWP muzzle fix: Barrel attachments display correctly.
[] Inventory sale crash: Vending functionality restored.
[] Shop visibility: Player markets now reliably accessible.
[] Tutorial reloading: Auto-replenish reactivated for new recruits.
[] Corpse drift: Black Goat-slain humanoids remain grounded.
[] Firearm textures: Errant weapon skins rectified.
[] Recipe reconciliation: Flour + Charcoal crafting now viable.
[] Errant dock waypoint excised from island maps.
[] Audio settings universalization: Muting globally silences all creature sounds.
[] G36C attachment alignment: Tactical gear and foregrips snap properly.
[] Cthulhu Statue insight loop: Infinite wisdom gain halted.
[] Multi-F-key conflict: Snow monoliths and final map prompts no longer lock progression.
[] Spawn freeze remedy: Fresh characters no longer experience weapon lockouts.
[*] Sea Cucumber Boss anchoring: Cadavers persist predictably post-defeat.

notes.title: No Escape From Madness - April 5th Optimization Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hotfix Update Based on Your Feedback[/h1]

After carefully reviewing player feedback, we've implemented immediate adjustments:

[olist]
[*] Looting time significantly reduced: 2.5s → 1s (60% faster!)
[*] Enemy AI rebalanced: No more "Flash-like" sprinting movements
[*] Experience improved: Fresh saves now begin with a fully-equipped bonus character (doesn't replace existing characters)
[*] Exploration made more forgiving: First-time map deaths now grant one free revival
[*] Zombie audio optimized: Temporary fix prevents repetitive moaning in large areas (full SFX remake coming later)
[/olist]

We're currently planning comprehensive visual, audio, and character design overhauls - see our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/3264820/announcements/detail/498317776823255849]previous announcement[/url] for preliminary details.

Help shape our next major update!
We're actively collecting detailed feedback on all platforms where you can reach us.

Thank you for your continued support as we keep improving the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266628/ee550844b284f7c34215a885cb7e92198955880a.png[/img]

notes.title: We need your battlefield wisdom! Submit feedback for us!
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience and feedback. We’re fully aware of the game’s current shortcomings, especially regarding early-game experience and overly "hardcore" mechanics. Based on your suggestions, we’re working around the clock to implement rapid optimizations. Here are the first-round adjustments:  

1. significantly reduced loot retrieval time for loading resources   
2. Humanoid enemy movement speed adjusted to normal values (no more "Flash-like" speed)   
3. Slowed Insight Value growth rate and reduced purchase cost for Insight Potions   
4. Armor defense mechanics rework for more balanced tactical choices   
5. Improved zombie audio performance (reduced repetitive/startling sound effects)   
6. New players now start with full Basic Gear Set equipped (no manual setup required)   
7. Reduced death penalties for first three matches of novice players   
8. Critical bug fixes for currently reported issues   

Next Major update:
We’ll completely renew the UI art system and optimize firearm textures in combat, along with refreshing Operator portraits, however those update contain huge workload, we will put the player experience at first place.

Please keep trust in us! The best is yet to come.

notes.title: March 19 Demo Version Update
notes.content:
The contents of this update are as follows:

Multiple backpacks will now open in sequence and be arranged separately, no longer overlapping with each other.
The size of an opened backpack now matches its actual size, eliminating any blank space occupation.
Adjusted the algorithm for selling items. For cases with nested backpacks, the price of items on every layer will now be calculated, instead of only accounting for the value of the first layer.
Adjusted some unreasonable fonts and item prices.

notes.title: 17.march Demo update
notes.content:
In this update, we mainly completed the following tasks:

Fixed the issue where a large purchase quantity in the store would exceed the game's maximum value, causing a negative amount.
Fixed the bug where "Reloading" was displayed when performing other actions while drinking water.
The custom key settings page now allows exiting by pressing ESC.
Fixed the bug where some slots in the warehouse were occupied by empty space after quickly switching equipment.
Adjusted the display of some fonts.
Now, after finishing a full magazine, the agent will reload automatically (please test this).
Fixed the bug where pressing F to force search was possible after opening the inventory in the game.
You can now exit the Save/Buy Preset Scheme page by pressing ESC.
